definitions.explanation: The quality or state of being cold. Formed from the adjective 寒い by replacing い with さ to create a noun expressing the degree or quality of coldness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寒|さむ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
{寒|さむ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えられない→耐える：12087_taeru⟧。

examples.english: My hands are numb from the cold.

notes:
{寒|さむ}さ is the noun form of the adjective ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧ (cold). The suffix ～さ converts i-adjectives into nouns expressing degree or quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寒|さむ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}える→耐える：12087_taeru⟧: to endure the cold
- {寒|さむ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧: the cold is severe
- {寒|さむ}さ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{震|ふる}える→震える：02411_furueru⟧: to shiver from the cold
- {寒|さむ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧: to get used to the cold

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧: heat (from ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧)
- ⟦{暖|あたた}かさ→暖かさ：21688_atatakasa⟧: warmth (from ⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧)
- {涼|すず}しさ: coolness (from ⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧)
